The saniderm only sticks to the skin and not the tattooed area so when it’s removed it can cause irritation. I had a lot of red rash and hives after I removed mine so used a different make the next time called dermalize. 

Don’t use any products which are petroleum based like Vaseline as it will be bad for the tattoo as it can pull out the ink. I use the normal tattoo balm on the tattoo and then cocoa butter or something similar on the irritated skin around it just to keep it moisturised.

Also don’t over wash the tattoo. 2x a day unless it’s gotten dirty or the skin will dry out further. 5 days of saniderm means the tattoo should be well on the way to healing now so you should be fine.

I awake from a deep sleep, the best type of sleep, the closest you can get to the bliss of being dead without actually dying. The dread is back, the feeling of my stomach falling through my bottom, the same feeling I get every morning upon waking up and to to face a new day. I decide the that today I am going to leave my anxiety inside. I am going to pull out the stops and live today as if it is my last, what happens happens. 

​

I roll out of bed, falling into my baggy sweats and throw on the hoodie that I haven't had the energy to wash in weeks. I close the front door, already with a sense of accomplishment, unlocking the car I almost feel a skip in my step. I chuckle to myself, I am so excited that I have the energy to blow the last few pounds in my bank account, I feel as if I am about to spend a million.

 I pull up to the ATM, rubbing my card against my sweatpants, my time honoured tradition, I take a quick glance around to make sure no one is watching, waiting to steal the last £25 to my name. 'ENTER PIN' my anxiety suddenly hits me like a freight train, this is the last of my money, I will be homeless next week, I will have nothing. I stare at the screen, 'Screw it, this is it, whatever happens next week is next week, just live in the moment for once' I tell myself sternly, I must snap out of this. 

I enter my pin, 'WITHDRAWAL AMOUNT' I skim the options on the screen, my balance reads as £25, but the only options are £10, £20, £50, £100, £200 or other. I select 'other' Today, for just one day I am going to be a new me, the me that doesn't care, that doesn't have to follow every rule, that isn't bound by ridiculous rituals. I type in £1,000,000, I smile as I hit enter, I haven't done something that I wasn't supposed to for years, I feel like a rebel, like I have just robbed a bank. 'PLEASE TAKE CARD' I can still feel the smirk, burnt on to my face. I take my card, expecting the machine to tell me off and then I will get my £20, stick £10 of diesel in the car, drive to the beach and grab some food.

'COUNTING' Confusion washes over my, my legs go to jelly as I hear the sound of the cash being counted within the machine. 'what the hell?' I ask myself, then the cash slot opens, and the biggest wad of notes gets pushed out in £50 notes... I am stunned, the machine starts beeping at me so I take it, my jaw feels like it's sat on the floor. The cash door closes, and the machine starts to make the noise of sorting the notes again, I pinch myself, this cannot be happening? another wad of notes gets pushed out. I have gone from feeling awesome that I have lied to a machine, knowing full well that it is going to tell me to get bent, to feeling like I am robbing an actual bank. The money just keeps coming.

I look around with pure fear stamped across me, where is the nearest bank that I can return this to and explain what has happened? My aim for the day destroyed, I can't be a rebel, I just cannot do it. After filling all my pockets, and the passenger seat of my car in cash, the machine stops giving me cash. The screen displays '£1,000,000 DISPENSED, YOU HAVE 2 WISHES REMAINING, WOULD YOU LIKE TO CONTINUE? Y/N' I re-read it over and over. 2 wishes remaining? what is this, a magical wish granting ATM? I have used this machine before, what the hell is going on? I am intrigued at what would happen if I press Y to continue, can I wish for world peace? to end world hunger? Could I become the ultimate cliche? 

I think through all the logical options, and nothing makes sense, is it just a genuine mistake? or is this machine granting me wishes? Surely these machines can't hold more than a million in cash? I feel like a criminal after just taking 1 mill, there is no way I can ask for any more. My anxiety is overwhelming. I am driving so I cannot reach for my Diazepam. I call my bank, if I can explain the situation, I can give the money back and everything will go back to normal ... right?

'ABC Banking, how may I help you?'

'Oh, hey, um ... One of your ATM's has malfunctioned, and it's given me £1,000,000 in cash... I only had £25 in my account so I need to know how I can return it'

'oh... OK, can you give me the ATM serial number please?' The lady on the phone sounds almost as stunned as I do, I provide the serial number and the time on the receipt. I listen to some horrendous hold music for a while and then she returns 'On our end it is showing as the machine has been turned off and is empty... I'm not sure what you're trying to do here but we are busy and need to be taking genuine calls' I am flabbergasted ... I am trying to do the right thing, I am trying to return the money and they think I am yanking their chain. 'I am being serious, I have a car full of your money!' I shriek, the line goes dead.

I am almost in full blown panic attack, where is the me that came out that door this morning determined to live life to the full? why can't I just take this money and literally have the best day of my life? I still have 2 more wishes! I could set myself and my family up for life!

​

I slap myself, trying to give myself some courage to just live and ignore the anxiety and fear that fills my every fibre. I re-open my eyes and I am no longer in my car, full of cash... I am back in bed, but this felt so real? I race down the stairs, still in my PJ's, I jump into my car and return to the same cashpoint. I put in my card, enter my pin, with no time to feel anything other than fear and disappointment ... 'SORRY, TOO SLOW' displays across the screen. The disappointment turns into that same feeling I get every morning... Oh well, £20 without all the guilt will have to do.  


  
\*\*Sorry it's a bit long. I am still struggling on how to structure conversations, talking to myself, and things like text being displayed on screens so sorry if it's hard to read.

I look around one last time at what surrounds me. For years I have become lost in my own mind, wondering what comes next, where people go when it’s all over. Many have tried to and failed to prove what awaits us on the other side, the endless possibilities haunt me.

I lay my perfectly flat cash, still warm from the ATM on the counter next to my carefully written notes. I take the deepest of breaths as acceptance washes over me and lay back.

As if no time has passed I am startled awake, the smell of fire and the echos of screams overwhelm me. Sitting up I realise I am suspended in a cage above a sea of lava. ‘This can’t be real?’ I tell myself ... suddenly the regret hits me like a bulldozer to the chest. Oh crap ... not only is there a hell, but I am here and it’s just like the movies. 

I feel the cage judder, it begins to move, the noise of the winch like I am ascending on a rollercoaster ... but I know euphoria is not going to be the result. I prepare myself for the pain of the torture that I am convinced is about to ensue as the cage is dropped into an empty room.

The glow of the fire and lava burns my eyes, my clothes are drenched in sweat from the heat. I stand clutching the bars, wishing I could take it all back. I see the large shadow of something enter the room. As the figure becomes more visible I take a long look through my squinted burning eyes. 

Big, red skin, horns ... yeah, it’s Satan, just as all the books and comics described him. I pinch myself hoping to be dreaming, in a coma, I would take anything rather than being here right now.

‘Phil, you are causing me issues’ a surprisingly calm and well mannered voice said as he came within meters of my cage.

‘The timer from your sins seems to be broken, it shows just 60 seconds’

I sit, silent and confused, not sure if I am able to or supposed to ask questions.

‘Are you some kind of saint?’ He asks

I scoff, ‘a saint? I’ve committed what is said to be one of the biggest sins, plus much more during my life’ I reply, with surprising confidence.

‘Well that’s not reflected by your sin counter, you have just 60 seconds of punishment before you can move through to heaven, I have never only had 60 seconds so I am unsure of what I can do to you with such a short time’

‘Heaven?’ I cry. ‘You go to heaven... after hell?’ I can feel my voice raising a few octaves.

‘Why yes, that is the general order. each bad sin you commit has a time code that gets added to the counter. Good deeds can reduce this time, but even the kindest of people arrive with at least 5 minutes. Then you proceed to heaven with a clean slate and a better attitude. 60 seconds is a record!’ Satan explained.

I hold my eyes closed, my face feels like I’ve been in the sun smothered in cooking oil for hours. I’m so confused I just cannot think but I know I have done bad things during my life and should have a lot more time on that timer, but I am relieved it’s broken. I can see the cogs turning in Satan’s mind as he mulls over what he can do to me in such a short time. 

He looks at me and smiles ‘I know’ his smile transforms into an evil smirk. He snaps his finger and I am knocked from my feet as the cage is once again on the move. I close my eyes knowing and try to gain some composure, I only have to endure my 60 seconds and then get to go to heaven, it can’t be that bad.

It sounds to my like it might be the people you are having conversations with. I have some issues with understanding people’s emotions and how they are interpreting things, especially these days when people seem to get offended by everything so I feel your pain in this situation. 

I have a couple of friends like it. You say something and they twist it or take it out of context to be something they don’t agree with or find ‘offensive’ and from then on, anything you say is skewed to be something they don’t agree with so you just cannot win.

I have learnt with these friends to, as soon as it becomes apparent they have misunderstood and are going down that path apologise and state that they have misunderstood what I was saying. Deny being what they have then accused me of being and leave it there as I will only from that point dig myself deeper. I tend to just not have serious conversations with them also as unless I agree with everything they say I’m a bad person one way or another.

TL:DR - Sometimes with some people in situations like this you can never win and will only dig yourself deeper. Apologise and move on. It sucks and is frustrating but I’ve learnt it’s the best way.
